task_summary: Predict 3D cell nodes and continuation/division edges from offline sequences, optimizing the official adjusted edge Jaccard plus 0.1 division Jaccard.
assumptions: Top five freeze the detector, encoder, coordinate head and tracker; only downstream selection, repair or scoring changes.
Sparse GEFF annotations provide known motifs and observable contradictions, not complete negative labels.
Training-side nested video predictions supply OOF-like conditioning; outer embryo evaluations remain conditional on pretrained-model exposure.
Available caches, exact solver constraints, current GPU quota and hidden cardinality are missing and must not be assumed.
Every full test requires unchanged outer-embryo conditioning, both embryo results and an offline hidden-inference smoke test.
All compute estimates are unmeasured proposal costs and must fit Kaggle's 12-hour notebook and 45 GPU-hour weekly constraints.
TF05 requires new image-model training and remains policy-deferred rather than being converted to a fixed-feature proposal.

closure_ledger.closed_instantiation: Flat learned mother-daughter set logits and pruning-only reopening fail divisions.
closure_ledger.not_closed: Pair ranking, separate cardinality scoring and alternative sparse-teacher objectives remain open.
closure_ledger.reason: All 128 covered outer divisions lose to subsets, but 42 true pairs rank best within pairs.

closure_ledger.closed_instantiation: Past-feature cross-attention used directly in the tracker fails its pair gate.
closure_ledger.not_closed: History as a motion reference, trust gate or uncertainty observation remains open.
closure_ledger.reason: This implementation uses sparse masks and GT-dependent window filtering; no official graph improvement was measured.

closure_ledger.closed_instantiation: The second direct past-attention tracker also fails both embryo progression gates.
closure_ledger.not_closed: Conditional false-edge filtering or reliability calibration remains untested.
closure_ledger.reason: 44b6 false edges decrease while recall falls, and masked-history outputs nearly match the augmented model.

closure_ledger.closed_instantiation: Unconditional edge expansion under unchanged additive costs worsens final official scores.
closure_ledger.not_closed: Expanded candidates as event alternatives, conditioners or uncertainty sources remain open.
closure_ledger.reason: Node recall and known-event coverage improve despite worse aggregate scores and optimal ILPs.

closure_ledger.closed_instantiation: More exact optimization of the same edge objective cannot explain the missed divisions.
closure_ledger.not_closed: Changed event objectives and faster solving that enables coupled edits remain open.
closure_ledger.reason: All eleven forced solves are optimal, and nine new divisions remain singletons under normal selection.

closure_ledger.closed_instantiation: Smaller center error cannot guarantee every video's graph or node-recall improvement.
closure_ledger.not_closed: Coordinate disagreement as calibration and separated geometry/feature-routing diagnosis remain open.
closure_ledger.reason: Aggregate official score improves by 0.0111095 while node recall declines and six videos worsen adjusted edge Jaccard.

idea_cards.title: Rank complete division and continuation events with separate cardinality scores
idea_cards.hypothesis: Separating daughter-set ranking from cardinality prevents covered divisions losing automatically to their singleton subsets.
idea_cards.changed_mechanism: Replace independent-edge or flat-set decisions with scored, mutually compatible continuation and two-daughter events.
idea_cards.input_target_decode: Frozen local graph to complete events; masked known-pair-versus-subset ranking trains a downstream scorer, then compatible event selection outputs edges.
idea_cards.deployment_error_simulated: Use real frozen graph ambiguities and remove one daughter from verified division conditioning.
preserved_invariants: Forward time and one mother per child remain enforced.
Known two-daughter motifs supervise complete events; unknown outdegree remains masked.
idea_cards.nearest_prior_attempt: E02 flat mother-daughter set selection misses every covered training and outer division.
idea_cards.exact_difference: Separate cardinality normalization and complete-event comparisons replace its collapsed flat-set logits.
idea_cards.counterevidence: Sparse divisions and absent verified nondivision labels can cause uncontrolled division inflation.
idea_cards.cheap_test: On saved known motifs, compare true-pair versus own-subset margins, edge recall, observable contradictions and divisions by embryo.
idea_cards.full_test: Run both conditional outer-embryo graph evaluations with the official scorer, then offline variable-dataset inference smoke.
idea_cards.kill_criterion: Stop before full graphs if training pairs still collapse or either embryo loses known edges or adds observable errors; reject official or runtime regression.
idea_cards.reopen_criterion: Reopen only with demonstrated pair-versus-subset selectability and unchanged sparse-label semantics.
idea_cards.coverage_test: Count complete division events available before scoring separately from missing-node and missing-edge failures.
idea_cards.selectability_test: Evaluate label-free complete-event selection on untouched outer embryos rather than reporting best-pair oracle recovery.
idea_cards.hidden_inference_contract: Only frozen predictions and sequence context enter the scorer; unsupported components retain the anchor graph.
idea_cards.compute_estimate: Cached CPU event audits precede small downstream training; exact event count and training cost are unknown.

idea_cards.title: Use the same sequence's robust motion as a physical reference
information_sources: Uncontested predicted links outside the query motif
idea_cards.hypothesis: Local common motion and residual dispersion distinguish ambiguous parents more reliably than absolute displacement alone.
idea_cards.changed_mechanism: Move history from tracker input to an independently estimated sequence-specific motion and uncertainty reference.
idea_cards.input_target_decode: Context links estimate physical residuals; masked known-parent ranking trains downstream calibration, then existing compatible events are selected.
idea_cards.deployment_error_simulated: Thin, duplicate, shuffle or delete context support and test queries outside its spatial coverage.
preserved_invariants: Use common physical units and forward-time links.
Exclude the queried motif from support and copy anchor outside reliable coverage.
idea_cards.nearest_prior_attempt: E03 and E07 inject past features directly into learned trackers.
idea_cards.exact_difference: A label-free entity-specific reference changes downstream interpretation without updating the tracker.
idea_cards.counterevidence: Incorrect anchor links can bias the reference, and meaningful shared motion is not established.
idea_cards.cheap_test: Measure residual variance and known-parent ranking versus global and sequence-shuffled references in each embryo.
idea_cards.full_test: Fit calibration inside each training embryo, evaluate official graphs on the other embryo, then smoke-test context absence.
idea_cards.kill_criterion: Reject absent conditional ranking lift, either-embryo observable error growth, official regression or failure to reproduce anchor without context.
idea_cards.reopen_criterion: Reopen when supported neighborhoods show stable residual reduction and target-free parent discrimination.
idea_cards.coverage_test: Report spatial, temporal and support-count coverage, including boundary and unsupported-query buckets.
idea_cards.selectability_test: Use observable support and residuals to select events without GEFF labels, checking held-embryo changes.
idea_cards.hidden_inference_contract: Unlabeled observations from the same test sequence are available; missing or unreliable context triggers exact anchor fallback.
idea_cards.compute_estimate: Robust context estimates and cached graph rescoring are CPU work; cache coverage and neighborhood cost are unmeasured.

idea_cards.title: Pretrain graph repair on measured imperfect conditioning and refine on real predictions
idea_cards.hypothesis: Repair training that reproduces correlated intermediate errors transfers better than clean-graph supervision alone.
idea_cards.changed_mechanism: Connect measured corruption, synthetic repair pretraining, real-prediction refinement and untouched outer evaluation in one experiment.
idea_cards.input_target_decode: Corrupted coordinate/score/adjacency subgraphs predict compatible graph edits through masked motif ranking, then edits are projected onto the frozen graph.
idea_cards.deployment_error_simulated: Measure bias, temporal autocorrelation, omissions, parent-rank swaps and division-to-singleton inversions before generating joint corruptions.
preserved_invariants: Verified graph teachers and unknown-label masks stay unchanged.
Recompute distances, neighbors and kinematics after corruption; synthetic inputs use geometry and scalar scores.
idea_cards.nearest_prior_attempt: E02 learns sparse set decisions but fails even covered training divisions.
idea_cards.exact_difference: Train explicitly from fallible conditioning, then briefly refine on real training-side predictions instead of relying on clean intermediates.
idea_cards.counterevidence: Sparse labels characterize only observable errors, and neither realistic corruption nor nested prediction caches are established.
idea_cards.cheap_test: Compare synthetic and real error distributions, pretrain repair on verified motifs, then test copy-through against short real-input refinement.
idea_cards.full_test: Choose corruption and refinement inside the training embryo, evaluate unchanged real predictions on the other embryo, then offline smoke-test.
idea_cards.kill_criterion: Reject corruption mismatch, clean-only gains, copy-through parity, either-embryo pair deterioration, official regression or excess runtime.
idea_cards.reopen_criterion: Reopen with representative real error statistics and evidence that synthetic-to-real refinement beats copying the anchor.
idea_cards.coverage_test: Report verified-motif and corruption-mode coverage separately from all unknown surrounding cells.
idea_cards.selectability_test: Measure whether the refiner chooses correct edits from real fallible inputs on held embryos without clean conditioning.
idea_cards.hidden_inference_contract: Only frozen graph outputs feed the refiner; GEFF and synthetic teachers are absent at hidden inference.
idea_cards.compute_estimate: Geometry-only pretraining needs small downstream training; OOF-like cache generation and refinement time remain unknown.

idea_cards.title: Fuse compatible event distributions before committing to one graph
idea_cards.hypothesis: Weak alternatives can expose uncertainty and improve selected events without replacing the anchor unconditionally.
idea_cards.changed_mechanism: Retain alternative event probabilities and decoder disagreement until soft fusion and compatible graph selection.
idea_cards.input_target_decode: Cached alternative event scores train masked reliability calibration; soft event distributions feed one constrained graph decode.
idea_cards.deployment_error_simulated: Remove alternative pools or invert score modes to test uncertainty gating and exact anchor fallback.
preserved_invariants: Fuse whole events rather than incompatible CSV rows or averaged coordinates.
Candidates share node identities and physical coordinates before joint selection.
idea_cards.nearest_prior_attempt: E06 adds low-score edges to the unchanged ILP and worsens both embryo scores.
idea_cards.exact_difference: Use permissive candidates as uncertainty-bearing alternatives with reliability calibration rather than unconditional edge expansion.
idea_cards.counterevidence: Alternative errors may be correlated, and high oracle coverage does not establish target-free selection.
idea_cards.cheap_test: Compare oracle event coverage, residual correlation and held-video selectability for hard top-one, soft fusion and conditional anchor gating.
idea_cards.full_test: Fit calibration inside training embryos, compare all three fixed fusion methods on outer official graphs, then smoke-test absent alternatives.
idea_cards.kill_criterion: Reject oracle-only improvement, incompatible graphs, either-embryo official regression or runtime growth beyond the measured budget.
idea_cards.reopen_criterion: Reopen with nonredundant candidate errors and separately verified target-free reliability ranking.
idea_cards.coverage_test: Measure truth inclusion and event completeness for each pool, grouping diversity by decoder, coordinate reference and dynamics rather than seed.
idea_cards.selectability_test: Test calibrated event choices on untouched embryos separately from oracle best-route and best-event scores.
idea_cards.hidden_inference_contract: Frozen-score alternatives require an offline cache or reproducible extraction; unavailable pools retain the anchor.
idea_cards.compute_estimate: Cached CPU fusion precedes graph decode; E06's expanded solve cost and 22.39GB peak make componentwise feasibility essential.

idea_cards.title: Cache exact independent solver components to enable coupled graph exchanges
idea_cards.hypothesis: Correctness-preserving component reuse makes complete multi-event exchanges affordable where repeated whole-graph solves are expensive.
idea_cards.changed_mechanism: Decompose the full variable-constraint incidence graph and reuse unchanged optima before enumerating coupled alternative events.
idea_cards.input_target_decode: Constraint-connected components retain the same objective and exact solutions; bounded multi-event alternatives are then scored and reassembled into a graph.
idea_cards.deployment_error_simulated: Stress dense components, long coupling chains, changed candidate cardinality and cache invalidation.
preserved_invariants: Every cross-variable constraint remains inside a component.
Original-objective edge sets and costs must match before any changed event search.
idea_cards.nearest_prior_attempt: E06 already obtains optimal ILPs but expanded solves total 2578.79 seconds.
idea_cards.exact_difference: Acceleration enables a changed coupled-event search; resolving the same objective more exactly is not an accuracy claim.
idea_cards.counterevidence: Global constraints or one giant component can eliminate decomposition gains, and exactness alone cannot recover rejected truth.
idea_cards.cheap_test: Benchmark full versus decomposed solves on cached graphs, requiring edge/objective parity and useful throughput improvement before event enumeration.
idea_cards.full_test: Run the enabled multi-event algorithm with official outer-embryo evaluation and offline cardinality/runtime smoke, comparing the unchanged anchor.
idea_cards.kill_criterion: Reject any parity failure, absent speed gain, cache-induced nondeterminism, memory regression or failure of the enabled algorithm's official accuracy gate.
idea_cards.reopen_criterion: Reopen with complete coupling definitions and measured decomposition gains on the worst graph components.
idea_cards.coverage_test: Report decomposable graph fraction and event-search coverage, including giant components that require global fallback.
idea_cards.selectability_test: The enabled algorithm must choose improved multi-event edits without labels; oracle enumeration alone cannot satisfy acceptance.
idea_cards.hidden_inference_contract: Discover components from actual test graphs, stream datasets, bound caches and fall back globally when coupling prevents decomposition.
idea_cards.compute_estimate: E06 has an 814.08-second maximum solve; proposed speedup and memory savings remain unmeasured.

idea_cards.title: Predict short tracklet identity permutations rather than individual edge repairs
idea_cards.hypothesis: A complete identity exchange can be recognizable across several frames even when each repaired pair is ambiguous.
idea_cards.changed_mechanism: Rank complete retain/swap/branch tracklet assignments over an ambiguous four-frame component.
idea_cards.input_target_decode: Tracklet tensors predict compatible identity permutations through masked known-path ranking, then replace only supported component edges.
idea_cards.deployment_error_simulated: Delete short histories and introduce correlated parent swaps within training-side verified paths.
preserved_invariants: Keep frozen nodes, physical units and one incoming mother.
Known paths supervise assignments while unannotated identity segments remain masked.
idea_cards.nearest_prior_attempt: E07 supplies history to individual tracker pairs without improving the early gate.
idea_cards.exact_difference: Temporal context scores complete graph assignments downstream rather than modifying individual tracker probabilities.
idea_cards.counterevidence: Wrong initial tracklets and short annotation coverage can propagate identity errors.
idea_cards.cheap_test: Enumerate small four-frame assignments and separate known-path oracle coverage from masked target-free ranking.
idea_cards.full_test: Evaluate fixed-window identity selection on both outer-embryo official graphs, then smoke-test short and boundary sequences.
idea_cards.kill_criterion: Reject no known-path lift, increased observable swaps, either-embryo official regression or combinatorial runtime failure.
idea_cards.reopen_criterion: Reopen when covered four-frame motifs contain selectable alternatives that pair-only choices miss.
idea_cards.coverage_test: Count complete supervised paths and available permutations, separately reporting annotation and frame-boundary limitations.
idea_cards.selectability_test: Score permutations from frozen sequence inputs without using the outer known identities.
idea_cards.hidden_inference_contract: Apply only to ambiguous bounded components; incomplete history copies the anchor assignment.
idea_cards.compute_estimate: Small cached permutation audits use CPU; component sizes and downstream training cost are unknown.

idea_cards.title: Use past-feature consistency to decide when an anchor edge deserves reconsideration
information_sources: Stored frozen past features if available
idea_cards.hypothesis: History consistency may identify risky edges despite failing as an additional direct tracker input.
idea_cards.changed_mechanism: Convert past-feature evidence into a downstream trust decision while preserving the public tracker.
idea_cards.input_target_decode: Feature continuity and graph disagreement predict observable edge-risk via masked ranking, then gate existing alternative events.
idea_cards.deployment_error_simulated: Mask or shuffle histories and compare with an otherwise identical geometry-only gate.
preserved_invariants: Keep tracker weights and candidate coordinates frozen.
Never infer true negatives from missing GEFF annotation.
idea_cards.nearest_prior_attempt: E07's history attention is almost unchanged when past inputs are masked.
idea_cards.exact_difference: History acts as a gate for graph reconsideration rather than an additive direct tracking predictor.
idea_cards.counterevidence: Near-parity under history masking suggests limited signal, and usable feature caches are not confirmed.
idea_cards.cheap_test: Audit feature availability and test conditional contradiction discrimination against masked, shuffled and geometry-only gates.
idea_cards.full_test: Train the gate within each training embryo, evaluate official outer graphs, then smoke-test complete history absence.
idea_cards.kill_criterion: Reject missing reproducible features, no history-specific lift, reduced known-edge recovery or official/runtime regression.
idea_cards.reopen_criterion: Reopen with manifest-verified features and a causal history-versus-masked discrimination difference.
idea_cards.coverage_test: Measure valid history length and feature coverage by density, time and embryo.
idea_cards.selectability_test: Check whether feature-based risk selects safer edits without labels on held embryos.
idea_cards.hidden_inference_contract: Equivalent frozen temporal features must be extractable offline; otherwise the gate leaves anchor unchanged.
idea_cards.compute_estimate: Cached feature gating is cheap CPU work, but missing temporal features may require costly frozen-model re-extraction.

idea_cards.title: Separate coordinate geometry from feature sampling and evaluator matching effects
idea_cards.hypothesis: Crossed frozen routes identify whether center correction helps geometry, changes scores through feature sampling or changes metric matching.
idea_cards.changed_mechanism: Cross zero/refined geometry with zero/refined feature sampling while separately locking candidate identities for auxiliary diagnostics.
idea_cards.input_target_decode: Four fixed coordinate/feature routes produce graph comparisons without new learning; official rematching remains the final outcome.
idea_cards.deployment_error_simulated: not applicable: this is a causal audit of existing frozen routes rather than simulated training corruption.
preserved_invariants: Keep model weights and downstream decoder fixed.
Locked-ID diagnostics remain separate from the official matching procedure.
idea_cards.nearest_prior_attempt: E05 improves official score but explicitly leaves coordinate and feature routes unseparated.
idea_cards.exact_difference: Isolate the two processing changes and rematching instead of interpreting the combined route as a single center effect.
idea_cards.counterevidence: Feature recapture may be required and fixed-ID correspondence can itself be ambiguous.
idea_cards.cheap_test: Use the 183 changed known-edge cases to audit locked identities, sample locations and score-routing parity.
idea_cards.full_test: Run all four predeclared routes through both embryo official evaluation, then verify any supported route with offline inference smoke.
idea_cards.kill_criterion: Reject causal conclusions if identities or feature inputs cannot be aligned; reject predictive adoption without separate official improvement.
idea_cards.reopen_criterion: Reopen with reproducible feature-location control and identity-safe paired evidence.
idea_cards.coverage_test: Report changed-edge and ambiguous-match coverage, including the six videos with worse adjusted edge Jaccard.
idea_cards.selectability_test: Any resulting route choice must use training-side observable diagnostics and be tested separately on outer embryos.
idea_cards.hidden_inference_contract: Audit labels never enter inference; deploy only a frozen route selected before outer evaluation.
idea_cards.compute_estimate: Saved official graph evaluation took 192.89 seconds, but crossed feature recapture cost is missing.

idea_cards.title: Generate independent trajectory proposals from temporal image components
idea_cards.hypothesis: Temporal foreground connectivity can recover proposals absent from the current point predictor without learning a new detector.
idea_cards.changed_mechanism: Construct image-supported temporal regions, centers and split proposals without the existing predictor or candidate list.
idea_cards.input_target_decode: Raw intensity volumes undergo fixed normalization and temporal-component scoring, then centers and forward links form an independent proposal graph.
idea_cards.deployment_error_simulated: Stress touching nuclei, intensity shifts, missing frames and field-boundary truncation.
preserved_invariants: Respect anisotropic physical coordinates and temporal direction.
Foreground components are observations rather than assumed dense cell labels.
idea_cards.nearest_prior_attempt: E06 expands edge candidates on existing detections rather than generating independent image proposals.
idea_cards.exact_difference: New proposals arise directly from temporal images and do not rely on current predicted points.
idea_cards.counterevidence: Touching cells can merge components, fluorescence is not conserved, and extra nodes can worsen official adjustment.
idea_cards.cheap_test: On preselected raw-image subsets, measure known-node/path coverage and observable merges against the current candidate ceiling.
idea_cards.full_test: After approval of the separate candidate comparison, evaluate target-free proposals on both embryo official graphs and offline image-processing smoke.
idea_cards.kill_criterion: Reject no new known-path coverage, unselectable excess proposals, official node penalty or image-processing runtime overflow.
idea_cards.reopen_criterion: Reopen with measured independent coverage and selectable proposals within the fixed-processing budget.
idea_cards.coverage_test: Compare independently recovered known nodes, continuation edges and complete divisions against anchor coverage.
idea_cards.selectability_test: Score independent proposals without GEFF at inference and evaluate selected graph accuracy separately from oracle recovery.
idea_cards.hidden_inference_contract: Raw test images are available offline; this is a separate candidate-generation comparison outside the fixed-candidate top five.
idea_cards.compute_estimate: Raw-volume rereading and temporal component memory are unmeasured; no GPU or 12-hour feasibility is guaranteed.

idea_cards.title: Augment geometry-only event scoring while corrupting observations and preserving teachers
idea_cards.hypothesis: Coordinate-invariant teachers and independently damaged observations discourage dependence on absolute position and unreliable score calibration.
idea_cards.changed_mechanism: Apply rigid physical coordinate relabelings to geometry-only motifs and calibrated score corruption while keeping known graph identity fixed.
idea_cards.input_target_decode: Transformed relative geometry and scalar scores train masked event ranking, then the scorer selects compatible events in original coordinates.
idea_cards.deployment_error_simulated: Perturb score bias and order using training-side observed calibration errors without treating labels as noisy observations.
preserved_invariants: Rigid coordinate relabeling preserves distances, topology and verified teachers.
Recompute geometric inputs; omit image features rather than assuming encoder equivariance.
idea_cards.nearest_prior_attempt: E03's feature-conditioned tracker depends on sparse and strongly incomplete pair supervision.
idea_cards.exact_difference: Train a geometry-only downstream event scorer under explicit coordinate invariance and observation-score corruption.
idea_cards.counterevidence: Useful kinematic relations are empirical and may shift by embryo; augmentation alone need not improve graph selection.
idea_cards.cheap_test: Measure motion and boundary residuals by embryo, then test coordinate invariance and clean-versus-corrupted event ranking.
idea_cards.full_test: Choose corruption inside training embryos, evaluate original-coordinate official outer graphs, then smoke-test score shifts offline.
idea_cards.kill_criterion: Reject unsupported hard invariants, noninvariant outputs, clean-only gains, either-embryo regression or runtime failure.
idea_cards.reopen_criterion: Reopen with supported geometric relations and real-score-shift generalization on held groups.
idea_cards.coverage_test: Report annotated motif coverage across density, boundary distance and time rather than assuming dense graph coverage.
idea_cards.selectability_test: Require target-free event ranking gains under real frozen scores, separately from synthetic reconstruction accuracy.
idea_cards.hidden_inference_contract: Inference uses original geometry and frozen scalar scores; transformed image features and GEFF metadata are not required.
idea_cards.compute_estimate: Graph-only augmentation is CPU-feasible in principle; downstream training and original-coordinate decode costs remain unmeasured.

portfolio.why: Task-first complete-event representation directly tests the documented pair-versus-subset collapse.
A cached sequence-local reference has a clear cheap variance test and explicit unsupported-context fallback.
The complete measured-corruption/pretrain/real-refine design tests robustness to imperfect graph conditioning.
Weak candidate pools become uncertainty before selection, with separate coverage and target-free selectability gates.
Exact component reuse must unlock coupled event search and pass its end-to-end official accuracy test.
